question:
Simplify the following expression.

12 + 11 - 13 + (4 + 3)
solution:
**Formula used:**

BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b85f6f9155b46d7ff3d549ba0a0da1fe9f95be993a1e930d360951a2d5f64825.png] 

**Calculation:**

12 + 11 - 13 + (4 + 3) 

⇒ 12 + 11 - 13 + 7 

⇒ 23 - 13 + 7 

⇒ 10 + 7 = 17

**∴ The value of the given expression is 17.**
